# v0.14

Released 2026-11-08.

## Highlights

- Login now happens in an embedded WebKit view in an always-visible bottom panel, and a
  login is required before Zwift launches; `--skip-login` opts out.
- Cookies persist between runs, and token-endpoint errors are reported instead of hanging.
- The smoke test's Zwift and winetricks downloads are cached, and incomplete installs are
  detected and skipped.
- Feral GameMode support removed.

## Commits

- launcher: remove Feral GameMode support (eac775f)
- snap: ignore aspell/hunspell enchant plugin lint warnings (ddc7795)
- launcher: show the login web view in an always-visible bottom panel (59567b7)
- tests: cache the smoke test's Zwift and winetricks downloads (579c50b)
- launcher: detect incomplete installs and skip the redundant download (24f301f)
- Use maintained version (f8dd773)
- Persist login WebView cookies and report redirect errors (e173c3d)
- Report token endpoint errors and time out token requests (d5bec2f)
- Install the wine prerequisites with a single winetricks invocation (a1f7130)
- Do not pass a login token when --skip-login is set (77414d5)
- Allow the pairing test more time to reach the pairing screen (ba9e4ed)
- Reword the in-workshop action runner error message (c0aca5c)
- Add a --skip-login flag to the launcher (40c99bd)
- Require embedded OAuth login before launching Zwift (f646dc3)
- Install only the newest local Zwift snap (2c6956b)
